messages:
maria: Quick check — planning to flip `autoscale.burst_v2` to canary in prod at 5% (targeting service: inference-gpu-pool). Can we confirm guardrails: `max_concurrency=60`, `queue_timeout_ms=200`, and fallback route to `cpu-fallback-1`? @drew @jen

Drew: @maria fine with 5% but we should watch p95 latency and OOM rate. Add a metric alert: `p95 > 300ms OR oom_rate > 0.5%` to auto-roll-back. :eyes:

ops-bot: Deploy job queued — canary rollout for flag `autoscale.burst_v2` at 5% targeting tag=canary. Job id: deploy-2026-0423-01. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/deploys/deploy-2026-0423-01

jen: Hold — GPU pool `eu-west-1-gpu-a` currently at 92% utilization, not comfortable. Recommend 1% in EU and 5% in other regions. :warning:

sam: Agree with jen. Also enable `circuit_breaker=true` (cooldown 60s) for the canary. If any node fails we should immediately funnel to non-burst.

maria: OK plan update: global 5%, eu-west-1 1%, circuit_breaker on. Adding alert rule per @Drew. Who can set the rollout window (start time)?

kevin: I can schedule it at 01:00 UTC tonight — avoids spike. I'll also pin a postmortem playbook link: https://go.redwood/internal/playbooks/autoscale-canary

tina: Confirmed region capacity snapshot looks ok for 01:00 UTC. I'll be on-call for the window.

Drew: Also add a temporary `max_concurrency_guardrail=100` for the canary to prevent runaway. We'll tighten after telemetry looks good.

maria: Putting changes in the feature-flag PR now:
```
{ "flag": "autoscale.burst_v2", "canary": {"global_pct": 5, "eu-west-1_pct": 1}, "guards": {"max_concurrency": 100, "queue_timeout_ms": 200, "circuit_breaker": true} }
```

jen: LGTM. I'll watch the infra dashboard and call abort if any OOMs. :thumbsup:

sam: FYI adding a short-run smoke test that hits long-context jobs to validate KV cache behavior during burst.

maria: Thanks all — I'm landing the PR and will post start time. If there's any pushback, ping here. :rocket:
